# pbs_sync_encryption_keys (Data Source)

Lists the sync encryption keys of a Proxmox Backup Server, PBS 4.2 or newer, archived ones included, without the keys themselves, which PBS never returns: those on which the provider's user or token has `Sys.Audit`, `/system/encryption-keys/<id>` or above; PBS leaves the others out.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pbs_sync_encryption_keys" "all" {}

# The fingerprint of each key, which the backups it encrypted carry: a
# restore needs the key whose fingerprint the backup shows.
output "sync_key_fingerprints" {
  value = { for k in data.pbs_sync_encryption_keys.all.keys : k.id => k.fingerprint }
}

# The keys PBS may still encrypt with, those not archived.
output "unarchived_sync_keys" {
  value = [for k in data.pbs_sync_encryption_keys.all.keys : k.id if !k.archived]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `keys` (Attributes List) The keys, sorted by ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--keys))

<a id="nestedatt--keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `keys`

Read-Only:

- `archived` (Boolean) Whether the key is archived: kept for decrypting, no longer used to encrypt.
- `archived_at` (Number) When the key was archived, as a Unix time; null while it is not.
- `created` (Number) When the key was created, as a Unix time.
- `fingerprint` (String) Fingerprint of the key, which the backups it encrypted carry; null when its key file has none.
- `id` (String) Key ID.
